sources.title: SC117/gemma-4-12B-it-heretic-QAT-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: UD-Q4_K_XL is the UD team's naming convention for its Gemma QAT Q4_0 GGUF variant. The repository or file name must not be interpreted as proof that the model uses mixed K-quants. In this release, the actual GGUF tensor information shows that the main model weights are stored as Q4_0, while normalization and scaling tensors remain in F32.

sources.snippet: Overview gemma-4-12B-it-heretic-QAT-GGUF is a 11.95-billion-parameter dense, uncensored variant of Google's Gemma 4 12B IT model. SC117 processed the QAT model with Heretic v1.2.0 using Arbitrary Rank Ablation (ARA) and row-norm preservation, then produced a Q4_0 GGUF file with a size of 6.4 GB.
